showrunner.description: THE LOOP: one live window end to end. Intake, triage, curate (subgraph), act (subgraph), wrap. What the dispatcher runs on every trigger

curator.description: Flow 1, rank and curate: score moments, score chat in parallel shards (Send map-reduce), themes, highlights, an editor's re-rank

action_desk.description: Flow 2, generate actions: recall what was done, propose, write a poll (subgraph), screen against policy and memory, approve per action (parallel interrupts), publish, remember

poll_studio.description: The first feature: three writers draft a poll for a live moment, a judge scores, a revise loop tightens it

memory_keeper.description: Learns from closed polls: outcomes, template preferences, lessons (Store, semantic search, memory-write interrupt)

recap_press.description: Half-time and full-time recaps from the ledger (Functional API: @entrypoint/@task, previous)

producer_chat.description: Ask the producer what it did and why (create_agent + tools over the ledger and memory, Studio chat mode)
